meta.title: HR Process SOP Manual
meta.subtitle: Employee Portal — standard operating procedures for every request
meta.intro: Each SOP describes the real, official process as it works in the system today — who raises the request, who approves it, what the system does, and its effect on attendance or pay. This manual replaces all earlier informal practices.
meta.footerNote: Confidential — internal use only. HR updates this document when the process changes.

sops.title: Leave (CL / SL / EL)
sops.sub: Applying for, approving and paying employee leave
purpose: This SOP defines how an employee applies for leave, how it is approved, and how approved leave is treated in payroll.
It applies to all employees who use the Employee Portal.
defs: CL / SL / EL and any other type HR has enabled; live balance is shown while applying.
Approved leave within balance — counted as present in payroll.
Leave beyond balance — treated as Loss of Pay and deducted.
steps: Open the Leave tile in the Employee Portal
Select type, from/to dates and a genuine reason; balance is shown.
In advance for planned leave; same-day with reason for emergency. Now Pending.
Reporting manager acts; Super Admin is always notified.
Approved paid leave counts as present; beyond balance becomes LWP.
roles: Applies with correct type, dates, reason; checks balance; tracks status.
Maintains balances; approved paid leave flows into payroll.
dos: DO — check balance and apply in advance.
DON’T — assume leave is granted until it shows Approved.

sops.title: Field Duty
sops.sub: Official work outside the office premises
purpose: This SOP defines how an employee gets approval for official work outside the premises and how that day’s attendance is recorded.
defs: Approved official work done away from the office for one or more days.
After approval, the Punch In/Out option appears on the employee’s Home for the approved day(s).
steps: Open the Field Duty tile in the Employee Portal
Choose duration + date(s) + reason, before the day.
Reporting manager approves; Super Admin notified.
After approval a Punch In/Out button appears on Home for the approved day(s).
Employee must Punch In on reaching and Punch Out after work — only then is the day recorded.
roles: Requests in advance; punches In/Out from the field.
Records field-duty attendance from the punches.
rules: Does NOT mark present — the employee must still punch.
The day remains absent until punched.
dos: DO — remember to Punch In and Out from the field.
DON’T — assume approval alone gives attendance.
